item.title: Rallying Cry – June 16, 2026
item.description: London’s West End will honor Dame Judi Dench with a theatre named in her honor, while Qatar steps up mediation efforts for regional peace, scientists uncover a hidden mathematical pattern in Chinese money plants, and Serena and Venus Williams aim for a historic doubles victory at Wimbledon.
